mapper.insert: insert into warehouse_material(warehouse_record_id, material_id, warehouse_num, inventory, product_date, expire_date, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{warehouseRecordId}, #{materialId}, #{warehouseNum}, #{inventory}, #{productDate}, #{expireDate}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update warehouse_material set inventory = #{inventory}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select * from warehouse_material where id in
#{id}

select wm.*, m.name as material_name, m.spec, m.price, mt.name as type_name from warehouse_material wm left join material m on wm.material_id = m.id left join material_type mt on m.type_id = mt.id where wm.warehouse_record_id = #{warehouseRecordId} order by wm.id

select wm.*, m.name as material_name, m.spec, m.price, mt.name as type_name, w.name as warehouse_name from warehouse_material wm left join material m on wm.material_id = m.id left join material_type mt on m.type_id = mt.id left join warehouse_record wr on wm.warehouse_record_id = wr.id left join warehouse w on wr.warehouse_id = w.id where wm.inventory > 0 and wr.status = 1 and wr.del_flag = 0
and wr.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
and m.name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%')
order by wm.create_time desc

select m.id as material_id, m.name as material_name, mt.name as type_name, m.spec, m.price, m.warn_threshold, coalesce(sum(wm.inventory), 0) as total_inventory, 1 as low_stock from material m left join material_type mt on m.type_id = mt.id left join warehouse_material wm on wm.material_id = m.id left join warehouse_record wr on wm.warehouse_record_id = wr.id and wr.status = 1 and wr.del_flag = 0 where m.del_flag = 0 and m.warn_threshold is not null group by m.id, m.name, mt.name, m.spec, m.price, m.warn_threshold having coalesce(sum(wm.inventory), 0) < m.warn_threshold order by m.id
select coalesce(sum(wm.inventory), 0) from warehouse_material wm left join warehouse_record wr on wm.warehouse_record_id = wr.id where wr.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and wr.del_flag = 0
